our_title: Fixed-vertex mapping hangs: 22c9c42e sizes merge hash table from fixed domains only
ran: gcc /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-playground/925301e5-494b-5a33-b598-8eaa63dd5c1d/scratchpad/work18/G25-metis-graph-part/repro/PS3-G25-1/fixmerge.c against pristine 7.0.18 (64-vertex ring, one fixed vertex, SCOTCH_graphMapFixed onto K32): 'timeout 20 ./fixmerge_asan 32' rc=124 (32- and 64-bit); gdb backtrace: '#0 _SCOTCHkgraphMapRbVfloMerge (mappptr=..., dfixmax=1, vfixnbr=1, ...) at kgraph_map_rb.c:430 #1 _SCOTCHkgraphMapRb kgraph_map_rb.c:176'. K4 returns normally. Patched (0007): 'returned 0, 32 distinct parts, p[0]=0', 32/64-bit; check_scotch_graph_map passes.
evidence: 'for (hashmsk = 1; hashmsk < dfixmax; hashmsk = 2 * hashmsk + 1) ; hashmsk = hashmsk * 4 + 3;' then 'for (domnnum = 0; domnnum < mappptr->domnnbr; domnnum ++) { ... for (hashnum = ...; ; hashnum = (hashnum + 1) & hashmsk) {' with no free slot once domnnbr > hashsiz

fix_options.label: A. hashnbr = mappptr->domnnbr + dfixmax (0007)
fix_options.summary: restore the 7.0.17 bound (domnnbr + vflonbr), with dfixmax for vflonbr
fix_options.maintainer_fit: one variable back, same idiom as his new loop

upstream_fix_review.details: Correct for kgraphMapRbVfloBuild (only fixed domains are hashed there) but in kgraphMapRbVfloMerge it dropped mappptr->domnnbr from the bound (7.0.17: 'hashnbr = mappptr->domnnbr + vflonbr'), while lines 419-431 insert every domain of the mapping. Any fixed-vertex mapping with more mapped domains than 4*(upper power of two of dfixmax) slots loops forever. check_scotch_graph_map does not catch it because its fixed-size targets have <= 5 domains.

notes: Merged into PS3-G12-1 (same defect, same hunk; G12 owns kgraph_map_rb.c and its patch carries the regression test). Former id PS3-G25-1.
